academic.input_zh: 已核验的 2026-08-12 Academic Wake Receipt；当前 main 分支 Scheduler V3.0 与 Worker Control v1.1.0；来自提交 c590482dc66d1729365863a44ded075ad9bd8611、完成 SHA-256 核验的 Academic Worker Prompt v2.0.0 及其全部必读来源；受治理 Research Queue 中符合 Academic 条件的 Q-20260803-09；Microsoft Research / arXiv 主要论文《Scaling Agents for Enterprise Multi-Horizon Task Execution》与官方 CorpGen 研究文章。
academic.workResult: Executed the complete Academic Deep Reading, Research Analysis, Research Writing, Visualization, Evidence & Citation and Publication Editing pipeline for one eligible primary research object. The analysis separates source-reported experimental results from Research Center interpretation and preserves the controlled OSWorld-derived benchmark scope, low absolute completion at the hardest load, the 11-execution limit of the artifact-evaluation meta-study, absence of independent reproduction identified in this run, and missing production guarantees such as restart-safe exactly-once work or transactional side-effect control. The resulting bounded judgment is that concurrent multi-horizon work should be treated as an explicit runtime scheduling, ownership/isolation, memory and outcome-evidence problem rather than merely a larger-context problem. A dedicated editorial cover was produced; no unnecessary Inline Figure was manufactured. Project relevance is none, so no first-party project mapping was inserted.
academic.workResult_zh: 针对 1 个符合 Academic 条件的主要研究对象，完成 Deep Reading、Research Analysis、Research Writing、Visualization、Evidence & Citation 与 Publication Editing 全流程。分析明确区分来源方实验结果与 Research Center 解释，并保留受控 OSWorld 派生基准范围、最高负载下绝对完成量仍低、Artifact Evaluation 元评估仅 11 次任务执行、本次未发现独立复现，以及尚未建立 Restart-safe Exactly-once 工作语义和事务性副作用控制等生产保证。最终有边界判断是：并发多时间跨度工作应被视为显式 Runtime 调度、所有权/隔离、记忆与结果证据问题，而不只是更大的上下文问题。已生成独立编辑题图；没有为满足数量而制造不必要的 Inline Figure。Project Relevance 为 none，因此未强制插入任何自有项目映射。
academic.output: Published one bilingual Academic Observation 003, Multi-Horizon Work Needs a Runtime, Not a Larger Context Window, with one dedicated editorial cover and durable governed Reading and Analysis artifacts.
academic.output_zh: 发布 1 篇双语 Academic Observation 003《多时间跨度工作需要 Runtime，而不只是更大的上下文窗口》，配套 1 张独立编辑题图，并持久保存受治理的 Reading 与 Analysis 产物。
academic.next: Test the paper's transferable runtime boundaries on independent non-OSWorld workloads: restart-safe task identity, ownership-scoped concurrency, fairness under reprioritization, shared-resource conflicts, and completion evidence that distinguishes artifact existence from authorized business acceptance.
academic.next_zh: 下一步应在独立的非 OSWorld 工作负载上验证可迁移 Runtime 边界：Restart-safe Task Identity、按所有权划分的并发、动态优先级下的公平性、共享资源冲突，以及能够区分 Artifact 存在与授权业务接受的 Completion Evidence。
